analyst.summary: HDFC Life's June-2026 quarter showed value of new business up 9% and margin held near 25%, but growth is now visibly slower than at least one direct peer, and the softness is concentrated in the HDFC Bank bancassurance channel that the company leans on most. Embedded value and solvency both remain healthy, and the stock trades at a lower multiple of embedded value than its own history -- so the reasonable case today is to hold and watch whether the bank-channel slowdown is really the cyclical blip management describes.
